description: This file declares utility functions related to RFC1123 time format strings, specifically functions to get the current time and convert Unix time to RFC1123 formatted strings.

methods.name: RFC1123_GetCurTime
methods.description: Generates the current time in RFC1123 format and stores it in the provided buffer.

methods.name: RFC1123_FromUnixTime
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to an RFC1123 formatted string in the provided buffer.
